title: manihot triphylla var. genuina
intro: Manihot triphylla var. genuina, commonly known as the wild cassava or manioc, is a type of plant species belonging to the Euphorbiaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and act as an antibacterial agent. The therapeutic actions of Manihot triphylla var. genuina include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help in managing conditions such as wounds, fever, and gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include saponins, flavonoids, and tannins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
